definitionZh: 网格启动的 CSS 属性指定网格项目在网格行内的起始位置,方法是为它的网格位置贡献一条线,一个横跨,或者什么(自动),从而指定其网格区域的内线启动边缘.
sourceDefinition: The grid-row-start CSS property specifies a grid item's start position within the grid row by contributing a line, a span, or nothing (automatic) to its grid placement, thereby specifying the inline-start edge of its grid areas.
